units.source_text: 正月初二日忙于招待贺客，举办临时宴会，竟日不曾与紫姬会面。

en.t: On the second day of the first month, he was busy receiving New Year visitors and holding an impromptu banquet, and he did not meet Lady Murasaki all day.

units.source_text: 公卿、亲王等照例个个都到。

en.t: As usual, every one of the court nobles and imperial princes came.
Before the hall, the sounds of flutes and strings filled the air.

units.source_text: 宴会之后分送珍贵的福物及犒赏品。

en.t: After the banquet, precious lucky gifts and rewards were distributed.

units.source_text: 云集于六条院的贺客，个个打扮得端端整整，力求不逊于他人。

en.t: The guests who gathered at Rokujo-in were all impeccably dressed, each trying not to be outdone by the others.

units.source_text: 然而略能比得上源氏的，一个也没有。

en.t: Yet there was not a single one who could compare even slightly with Genji.

units.source_text: 当时朝中人才济济，个别看来，原有不少优秀人物。

en.t: At that time the court was full of talented people, and judged one by one there were many outstanding figures.

units.source_text: 然而一到源氏面前，就全被压倒，真乃不胜抱歉。

en.t: But once they stood before Genji, they were all utterly overshadowed, almost embarrassingly so.

units.source_text: 即使是卑不足道的下仆，来到这六条院时也特别小心谨慎；

en.t: Even the humblest servants took special care and behaved with particular caution when they came to Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 何况那些青年王孙公子，知道这里新来了一个美人，大家都痴心妄想，别有用意。

en.t: All the more so the young princes and noblemen, who knew that a new beauty had arrived there and were each lost in infatuated hopes with private intentions of their own.

units.source_text: 因此今年的新春与往常不同，特别热闹。

en.t: For that reason, the New Year this year was unlike ordinary years and was especially lively.

units.source_text: 晚风和熙，吹送花香；庭前梅花数树，含苞逐渐开放。

en.t: The evening breeze was gentle and carried the fragrance of flowers; several plum trees before the garden were gradually opening their buds.

units.source_text: 暮色沉沉，人影模糊难辨之时，管弘之声悠扬悦耳。

en.t: When dusk had deepened and human figures were blurred and hard to distinguish, the sound of the pipes rose gracefully and pleasingly.

units.source_text: 歌人高唱催马乐“此殿尊荣，富贵双全。……”音调非常华丽。

en.t: The singers loudly performed the saibara song, "This hall is honored and flourishing, blessed with both wealth and rank..." and the melody was exceedingly splendid.

units.source_text: 源氏时时和唱，从“子孙繁昌”一直唱到曲终，歌声柔和可爱。

en.t: Genji joined in from time to time, singing from "may descendants prosper" all the way to the end of the piece, his voice gentle and charming.

units.source_text: 无论何事，倘有源氏参加，便蒙他的光辉照耀，色彩与声音都增加生气，其差别显然可辨。

en.t: Whatever the occasion, if Genji took part, it seemed illuminated by his radiance, and both color and sound gained new life; the difference was plainly visible.
